name: Dei Gratia
descriptionTemplate:
In boss battles only:
Godking gains 1 {Erosion} at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, the team takes damage equal to 10% of its Max HP per stack.
When an Awakener plays {Gnosis Rouse}, Godking gains 3 {Etched Memory}.
When your team is about to be defeated or after six turns elapse, Godking spends all Awakeners' Aliemus, loses all {Erosion} and Godking Authority, and becomes {Tulu: Theophany}.
